what: Round 15 starts by committing the uncommitted Level 8 work as 'R14 WIP: paused for UI overhaul' (2cadb05) and does not continue F62-F70 until the UI work is done.
why: Orchestrator instruction to stop feature work and make the UI overhaul the only goal.

what: Admin stays the JUDO default. Customer look changes go through view changes of the transfer objects (UI model) and src/custom hooks; no admin tidying except the Quote fix.
why: Owner decision given mid-round ('admin can stay judo default use view changes to the view model of TOs').

what: Live iteration loop: Vite dev server on port 5173 against the running Karaf backend on 8181 (VITE_API_DEFAULT_BASE_URL), edit src/custom with HMR, and batch UI-model changes into one generate-root plus 'build -f -i' (about 38 s) instead of full root builds.
why: Round brief requires fast iteration; the kb docs on the dev server, env variables and reckless/frontend-only builds were read first.

what: Customer layout becomes a top bar by setting menuOrientation=HORIZONTAL on webshop::Customer in the model (CLI update), not by a template override.
why: accesspoint.md documents menuOrientation on the actor (VERTICAL or HORIZONTAL); this is the documented model route.

what: Header extras (search box, language switch, currency switch, cart counter, notification bell, drawer expander) share the one AppBarExtraComponents slot through a single wrapper component AppBarExtras, with spaceRequired tuned to 4.
why: The generated header accepts exactly one AppBarExtra component (ui-hooks.md 'AppBar Extra Components').

what: Storefront menu is regrouped by a MenuItemsCustomizerHook in registerShellHooks.ts (sorted by title, fixed order) so the drawer shows Products, Cart, My account, Company and Sell groups.
why: ui-hooks.md 'Menu Manipulation' documents the customizer hook; generated item ids are model ids so titles are used for ordering.

what: Checkout becomes a four-step flow (address, delivery, payment, review) plus a confirmation page, built as a custom component (CheckoutFlow.tsx) on the cart page instead of a model Stepper; the new order is opened after the generated checkout operation succeeds.
why: Stepper in the UI mapping docs is described for forms; the operation flow is a custom implementation (custom-visual-element-override.md). registerCheckoutHook navigates to the newest order.

what: No .generator-ignore entry and no extra route for a /checkout URL; the checkout flow is reached from the cart page only.
why: Standing rule forbids .generator-ignore entries; extension-points.md documents extra routes only through src/extra-routes.tsx, which needs an ignore entry to survive regeneration.

what: Level 8 specs buy a product created in the same run (shops[0].product) instead of the shared seed products Trail shoe and Trail mix, so repeated runs do not depend on seed stock.
why: Repeated runs had used up the seed stock; the old tests depended on it.
workaround: Tests use run-local products; admin restock was tried and dropped.

what: The builder ran long chains of source reads (grep, sed, cat on catalog and generated code) without kb_search. The guard warned many times, and the orchestrator had to say 'use kb'.
why: Builder defaulted to source search despite the standing kb-first rule.
workaround: Builder switched to kb_search for the checkout and widget questions after the orchestrator correction.

what: Setting textWidget=TEXT on read-only string fields removed their labels in the generated order view (values with an icon, no label). The change was reverted to INPUT; the 'read-only shows as text' requirement is not met.
why: The kb says TEXT means read-only but says nothing about labels; the generated theme styles read-only inputs but the builder found no documented labelled-text route.
workaround: Reverted all 158 fields to INPUT via .scratch/r15-model.py; relied on the generated theme read-only styling.

what: Customers with a saved browser config keep the old vertical drawer because the layout is stored in localStorage under 'webshop-config', which overrides the new model default.
why: Stored client config wins over the generated default layout; the builder found it by testing and cleared localStorage in the browser.
workaround: Cleared the localStorage key in the test browser; real users are not migrated.

what: No documented way to hide the generated 'Check out' dialog action on the cart page, so the old and new checkout both exist.
why: Hiding a generated action needs a hiddenBy boolean in the model; the builder left the model change for the owner.
workaround: Left the generated checkout dialog in place; documented in GAPS R15-3.

what: A custom page route for checkout needs src/extra-routes.tsx, which needs a .generator-ignore entry, which the standing rules forbid. So the step flow cannot have its own URL.
why: Extra routes are generated empty and only survive regeneration with an ignore entry; the standing rule and the route need conflict.
workaround: Flow lives inside the cart page; no /checkout URL.

what: The kb gives the Stepper widget (a form layout) as the step-flow answer; no catalog entry covers a multi-step operation flow like checkout.
why: kb_search for 'multi-step wizard stepper checkout flow' matched form widgets only.
workaround: Built a custom component instead of a model Stepper.

what: A long single test (several minutes with 3-width screenshots) hit ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED; the overhaul spec was split into two tests with a login each.
why: Access token lifetime is shorter than the test; kb search for token renewal in e2e found only error codes, no renewal guidance.
workaround: Split the spec into two short tests.

what: The model build logged many 'XMI ID COLLISION DETECTED' errors for Admin tabular reference field actions, but the build still reported BUILD SUCCESS.
why: Not investigated in this chunk; likely a model/ID issue in the admin UI model.
proposed_target: judo model XMI ids for Admin tabular reference actions

what: judo query on StringType with --select textWidget fails ('not a field'); textWidget lives on DataField, and the error lists valid fields without saying which type owns the attribute.
why: Attribute is on DataField, not on the data type; the CLI does not point to the owning type.
workaround: Queried DataField instead.
proposed_target: judo-cli query error message (owning type hint)

what: A batch of 178 judo update attribute changes produced 20 errors: 'element not found' for view fields that do not exist (email, ratingLabel, soldBy, remainingCreditLabel) and textWidget refused on a unit field. No listing of which attributes each view has.
why: Builder guessed the view attribute names from the TO fields; the CLI gives no per-view attribute list.
workaround: Accepted the 158 ok changes and skipped the 20 bad ones.

what: The batch script used 'declare -A', which the macOS bash does not support; the script failed and was rewritten in python.
why: Builder assumed a newer bash.
workaround: Rewrote the batch as python3.

what: The Playwright e2e suite runs against the packaged app on port 8181, so the fast Vite loop does not cover it. Each e2e verification needed a full judo.sh build (about 4.5 min per run).
why: No documented way found to point the e2e suite at the dev server; the kb guidance covered only the dev server for manual checks.
workaround: Ran the full build script in the background (.scratch/r14-rebuild.sh) before each e2e run.

what: Repeated e2e runs used up the shared seed stock (Trail shoe, Trail mix) and left about 77 products; Level 8 tests failed on out-of-stock and admin restock timed out for Trail shoe.
why: Tests shared seeded products and did not reset them.
workaround: Run-local products (see c10-09); restocked Trail mix and Wool socks through the admin UI.

what: Admin restock locator /^Stock/ matched two elements (Stock and Stock status), so the first restock script failed in strict mode.
why: Label regex too broad for the admin form.
workaround: Changed the regex to /^Stock(?! status)/.

what: Admin Products table shows 10 rows per page, so sellers' products beyond the first page are not found by the e2e helpers; a showAllRows helper selects the largest page size.
why: Default paging in the generated back-office table; the test helper assumed one page.
workaround: Added showAllRows to helpers-customer.ts and used it in adminEditProduct and level7.

what: Moving the customer menu into drop-down groups broke older specs that expected flat menu entries; clickMenu and menuCount helpers were added, and menu lookups needed retries because the menu is rebuilt after an approval.
why: Role-based locators assumed the old flat menu; the principal-driven menu changes a moment after approval.
workaround: Added MENU_GROUPS, clickMenu, menuCount and a 15-try retry loop in helpers-customer.ts.

what: The F59 smoke test depended on earlier tests having filled the cart and stock; it failed when run alone (waitForResponse on ~get timed out).
why: Order-dependent test state.
workaround: Test orders 30 units itself so it works alone.

what: The F70 refusal check expected 'You have 82 loyalty points', but the checkout was refused by the order-value rule (TOO_MANY_POINTS from CheckoutCustomImplementation.java) because the cart was worth less than the points.
why: Test chose a cart too cheap for the points rule to be the one that refuses.
workaround: Test adds a more expensive product (shops[0].product) before the 500-point attempt.

what: The F70 expiry check looked for a toast 'loyalty points expired'; the admin operation shows the message in a dialog text box.
why: Test assumed a toast; the operation's result is in a dialog field.
workaround: Assert the dialog Message textbox value, then click Back.

what: The orchestrator asked for the admin Quote page 'Requested' and 'Order' fields to be read-only; no change for this is seen in the chunk and the final report does not mention it.
why: Requested item dropped while working on the customer UI.

what: Standalone Playwright scripts with 'import playwright' failed (module not found, browser not installed); probes had to run through the project's 'npx playwright test' runner.
why: Script environment not set up for plain node use of the e2e dependency.
workaround: Wrote temporary spec files (zz-probe.spec.ts) and deleted them after each run.

what: Vite could not Fast Refresh a component file that also exports a non-component (renderNothing), so the page reloaded fully on each edit.
why: React Fast Refresh only handles component-only exports.
workaround: Accepted the full reload.

what: Custom menu groups were first typed 'collapse' and then changed to 'group' after the drawer rendered wrong.
why: Not stated in the chunk; the group type fits top-level menu groups in the horizontal bar.
workaround: sed change of the type to 'group'.

what: Language switch kept in the header through the AppBarExtras wrapper (EN/HU).
why: Shared AppBarExtraComponents slot.

what: Notification bell kept in the header with the unread count from the profile.
why: Shared AppBarExtraComponents slot.

what: Storefront overhaul: top bar with cart counter and search box, grouped menu, home hero and category chips with sort, card grid, category filter, four-step checkout with confirmation page, account group. Admin untouched.
why: Round 15 UI brief.

what: Level 8 marketplace spec F62 and F63-F66 pass (6 tests in level8 pass after helper and fixture fixes).
why: Finish Level 8 after the UI overhaul.

what: Level 8 gift card (F69) and loyalty points (F70) tests pass on run-local products.
why: Finish Level 8.

what: Smoke suite (--grep @smoke) passes 7 of 7 after helper and fixture fixes (showAllRows, F59 orders 30 units).
why: Regression after menu grouping and paging changes.
